build_mpt_causal_lm: build an MPTForCausalLM model from a VllmConfig for causal language modeling with tied word embeddings
create_mpt_attention: create an MPTAttention module with tensor-parallel head partitioning and ALiBi slope computation
run_mpt_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MPTModel transformer blocks with input IDs and position IDs
load_mpt_weights: load pretrained weights into MPTForCausalLM using AutoWeightsLoader with parallel linear layers
compute_mpt_logits: compute logits from hidden states using the MPTForCausalLM logits processor and tied lm_head
